title: vatica grandiflora
intro: Vatica grandiflora, commonly known as the Borneo ironwood, is a species of tree in the family Dipterocarpaceae. This tree is native to the rainforests of Borneo and is highly valued for its timber, which is known for its durability and resistance to decay. The health benefits of Vatica grandiflora include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its high antioxidant content. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties.
